During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] was '''invaded''' by Imperial forces. In the wake of the invasion, many [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] took up arms against the Empire, committing acts of [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] and [[Thief/Legends|theft]] to avenge their conquered [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="CCG-Elom">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Elom}}</ref>
